description: REQ-203's PROP-203c Tier-0 acceptance criterion is explicit and directly checkable right now, against real, already-existing artifacts: 'Every process-launch boundary used by REQ-302/303 explicitly sets HOME/ANICCA_HOME in its own artifact (SDL env:, job-definition env, cloud-init Environment=) -- never relies on a base-image default' (verification-architecture.md PROP-203c). Reading the actual, real, currently-existing artifacts this spec cites shows this criterion is currently FALSE for both of them: neither `deploy-akash.sh`'s own inline default SDL (the fallback used whenever `AKASH_SDL_TEMPLATE` is unset) nor the real, pre-existing external template `~/anicca/skills/self/spawn-child/sdl/child.yaml` (the ONLY external SDL template that exists anywhere in this codebase) sets `HOME` or `ANICCA_HOME` anywhere in their `env:` block -- both set only `AUTOMATON_GOAL=earn` and `ANICCA_CHILD_ID=${CHILD_ID}`, leaving `HOME` to whatever the `node:22-bookworm` base image's default user resolves to (implicitly `/root` for the default root user, i.e. a literal base-image default -- the exact thing this acceptance criterion prohibits). Since REQ-303 (PROP-303a) simultaneously requires these exact scripts/SDL artifacts to be reused 'with zero source modification (only CHILD_ID/SDL substitution)', REQ-203 and REQ-303 as currently specified cannot both be satisfied without a real SDL edit this spec never acknowledges is needed -- the identical 'falsely-claimed unmodified reuse' pattern iteration 1's FIND-001 (child-spec.js) and iteration 4's FIND-305 (akt-treasury.sh price oracle) already caught elsewhere in this same document, now recurring for the Akash SDL artifact and left uncaught through 4 prior review iterations because no reviewer had yet located and read the actual, pre-existing external SDL template this spec's REQ-303 implicitly depends on.

evidence.snippet: 'Every process-launch boundary used by REQ-302/303 explicitly sets HOME/ANICCA_HOME in its own artifact (SDL env:, job-definition env, cloud-init Environment=) -- never relies on a base-image default | 0 | true | structural read of the actual SDL/job-definition/cloud-init artifact used for a real deploy, confirming the explicit env line is present'

the inline default SDL's env block: '- AUTOMATON_GOAL=earn', '- ANICCA_CHILD_ID=${CHILD_ID}' -- identically missing HOME/ANICCA_HOME
